answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 9 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a voyage bet on surviving 99 epochs of grading, and every willow settlement recomputes the vine schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 99 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
